name: Reploid Angel - Cinnamon
desc:
2 "Maverick" monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can send from your Deck 1 "Maverick Analyzer" or "Maverick Boost" card to the GY. During opponent's Main Phase: You can return this card to the Extra Deck; negate 1 face-up card your opponent control. You can only use each effect of "Maverick Angel - Cinnamon" once per turn.
